convert_obj_to_mujoco_msh: convert an OBJ mesh file to binary MuJoCo MSH format by parsing and relabeling vertices
parse_obj_file: parse an OBJ file from a path into a list of meshes with vertices, faces, texcoords, and normals
convert_mesh_to_msh_binary: convert mesh vertex, face, texcoord, and normal lists into a binary MSH format string
relabel_obj_vertices_for_mujoco: relabel OBJ mesh vertices, texcoords, and normals to a MuJoCo compatible flat format
flatten_nested_lists: flatten a sequence of sequences into a single flat list using itertools
